info.title: Email Platform API
info.description:
Version 1 of the email platform HTTP API.

Errors use [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) Problem Details
(`application/problem+json`).

OpenAPI document: `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`

delete.description: Hard-deletes the domain, all mailboxes, messages, and R2 objects.

post.summary: Start or return active domain validation run
Cancel an in-progress domain validation run

delete.description: Hard-deletes the mailbox, its messages, and R2 objects.

get.description: Own (primary mailbox) identities, the instance default identity, and identities from shared mailboxes the account can access.

get.summary: List identities available when composing from a mailbox

get.description: Returns DB metadata only (no R2 parse).
Parses the stored raw EML from R2.
Returns the stored raw EML bytes from R2.

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: When set, only threads with this label are returned.

parameters.name: includeBody
parameters.description: When true, includes full message text, html, and attachments for each message.

get.description: Inbound messages and outbound drafts/sent messages.

201.description: Created client (clientSecret returned once when confidential)

get.summary: List consent grants for a client

302.description: Redirect to login, consent, or client

bearerAuth.description:
Use an API key in the `Authorization` header:

`Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`

User API keys start with `fmu_`. Effective access is the holder's
normal account permissions intersected with the key's scopes.

personalIdentityAllowance.description: Shared mailboxes only. When true, senders may select identities owned by their primary mailbox while composing from this mailbox.

identityExport.description: Shared mailboxes only. When true, this mailbox's identities may be selected when sending from other mailboxes the account can access.

isSystemManaged.description: True for platform-provisioned addresses that cannot be edited or deleted.

identityExport.description: When true, these identities may be selected when sending from other mailboxes.

identityId.description: Identity used for the From name. Signature should already be in the body; the server does not re-append it.

replyAll.description: When replying via draft, include all visible thread participants (From, To, Cc, Reply-To) except the sending mailbox. Ignored when explicit `to` recipients are provided.

subject.description: Optional. When omitted, defaults to `Re: <parent subject>`. Does not prepend another `Re:` when the parent subject already starts with `Re:`.
Optional. When omitted, defaults to `Fwd: <parent subject>`. Does not prepend another `Fwd:` when the parent subject already starts with `Fwd:`.

includeAttachments.description: When true, copies attachments from the forwarded message.

includeQuotedBody.description: When true, appends a quoted copy of the parent message below the optional intro text. Set false when the client already included the quote in `text`/`html`.

inReplyTo.description: Parent message id within the thread, when this message is a reply.

text.description: Present when includeBody=true on list thread messages.

html.description: Present when includeBody=true on list thread messages.

attachments.description: Present when includeBody=true on list thread messages.

sentBy.description: Present only when viewing a shared mailbox. Internal-only identity of the user who sent the outbound message.

seenBy.description: Present only when viewing a shared mailbox. Users who have read this message.

sender.description: From header of the latest message in the thread.

participants.description: Unique participant email addresses in the thread, excluding the viewing mailbox.

seenBy.description: Present only when viewing a shared mailbox. Seen-by list for the latest message in the thread.
